name: list_case
description: Browse the case as a tree. Call with no path to see the top level (/case, /messages, /documents), or with "/messages" or "/documents" to list their entries. Open an entry with read_case.

path.description: Directory path, e.g. "/" or "/documents". Defaults to "/".

name: read_case
description: Read one case file by path, e.g. "/case", "/messages/003" or "/documents/policy-copy.pdf". Documents come back as extracted text.

name: search_case
description: Search the whole case, or one directory, with a case-insensitive regular expression. A plain word or phrase works. Each match comes back as a path with a #L line number.

name: send_message
description: Send a message to someone on the case: the customer, an insurer, a contractor, an internal team or system. It is delivered at once; replies arrive later as new messages.

to.description: Recipient as named in the case, e.g. "Jess Moore" or "Wrenfield Property Insurance".

channel.description: How it is sent, e.g. Email, Secure portal, SMS, Call. Defaults to Email.

name: add_note
description: Write an internal note on the case record. Nobody outside sees it.

name: close_case
description: Close the case when it needs nothing more from you. Give a one or two sentence outcome.

name: run_subagent
description: Hand a task to a sub-agent and get its reply. It sees this case as it stands, can search the web and other clients' past claims, and cannot act. For complex or uncertain cases, ask one reviewer to derive the required actions from the case without your plan, and another to check your complete proposed action set. Research should address a named uncertainty. Several calls in one response run in parallel; wait for relevant results and check them against the case before dependent actions.

instruction.description: The task, self-contained: the sub-agent sees the case but not your thinking.
